description.value:
Duration constant

Nothing that closes on you gets to answer the shot that met it.

Your ranged Strikes made as reactions do not trigger reactions from the creature you are attacking, and firing a ranged weapon while within an enemy's reach does not make you off-guard or trigger its Attack of Opportunity.

cinderfall.incomplete: this suppresses a Cinderfall house-rule penalty (ranged Strikes within melee reach → off-guard + trigger an AoO-style reaction) that isn't itself encoded anywhere in this corpus or in real PF2E (which has no universal "ranged-in-melee causes off-guard" rule — Attack of Opportunity/Reactive Strike is a specific class/monster reaction, not a baseline penalty). There's nothing here to suppress with a rule element.
